title: Great tour, great guide!
text:
Fabulous tour with Roberto! Really good instructions & also loads of history of places along the river. Very relaxed way to see the city & the turtles on the river too!! 
Lovely way to spend a few hours & Robertos English was fantastic! 
Highly recommend this tour for something a bit different!

title: We will repeat again

title: Amazing explained in the river

title: Seville from a different perspective!
text: Fun activity led by Roberto. It might have been even more fun at a different time (in the morning or in the evening). At the end of the afternoon it was very hot! But the water was cooling.

text:

title: Great Way to know the city history
text:
Roberto is a great guide to the river, orgial from Triana he makes sure everyone no matter they experience with SUP has a great time. He shares the city history ans anecdotes of each monument.
